title: AI secondary review: 12 frozen cases
method: Codex (AI) manually inspected all 12 A/B source excerpts and outputs and compared them with CHIA annotations; exact-match counts were recomputed by script. This is not an independent clinical adjudication.

ai_notes.finding: A labels the substring age inside gastro-oesophageal as a Measurement. Although the characters occur in the source, they are not a standalone entity. B recovers two repeated time windows and Child-Pugh score, but produces many false positives by labeling disease names, a single letter and abbreviations as Measurements.
ai_notes.boundary_and_omissions: B includes an extra closing parenthesis in > 6) and an extra for at the start of for 1 month prior to the enrollment in the trial. It still misses target entities such as New York Heart Association.
ai_notes.context: This is an exclusion criterion. Extracting a disease name or threshold does not parse the exclusion logic and cannot support a patient eligibility decision.

cases.source: pregnant women in 30 to 32 weeks of gestation, with positive HBsAg and HBeAg,serum viral load above 8log10 copies per mL

ai_notes.finding: A and B both retain HBsAg, HBeAg and serum viral load. B adds positive but also returns a truncated serum viral span alongside the complete entity. Both label 30 to 32 weeks as Temporal; in this record, the gold labels the phrase as Value and gestation as Measurement.
ai_notes.boundary_and_omissions: B includes an extra in in in 30 to 32 weeks and misses gestation. Both systems miss above 8log10 copies per mL. The revised combination has a lower exact F1 than the original on this case, so the report should not show only examples that improved.
ai_notes.context: Here, gestational age is labeled as a measurement value, not a relative event-time window. The fixed task labels and context govern this comparison.
evidence_quotes: serum viral load above 8log10 copies per mL

ai_notes.finding: A returns the full within the past year, then also returns the shorter past and labels the same window as Value. B retains no entities.
ai_notes.boundary_and_omissions: A truncates > 5 events per hour to > 5. Neither system fully extracts apnea hypopnea index and its value. Renal function is not labeled Measurement in this record's target gold; this review does not independently judge whether that annotation is clinically appropriate.
ai_notes.context: The time window, index name and unit convey different information. Keeping only 5 loses the per-hour event rate.

ai_notes.finding: The gold contains no target Measurement, Value or Temporal entities. B's empty output is an exact document match under this task's gold. A labels descriptions of pregnancy or breastfeeding, legal protection and insurance as Measurements, which do not match the target labels.
ai_notes.boundary_and_omissions: B has no false positives or false negatives within the scope of this task. This does not mean these eligibility conditions are absent or unimportant.
ai_notes.context: This review scores only three entity categories; it does not decide eligibility based on legal clauses or pregnancy status.

cases.source: Methadone-maintained cocaine-dependent patients use between 1g to 2g a day; 1 to 3 times a week

ai_notes.finding: Both systems label quantity or frequency as a target entity. The complete annotation file labels 1g to 2g a day and 1 to 3 times a week as Multiplier, and cocaine-dependent as Condition. The target gold is therefore empty for this task.
ai_notes.boundary_and_omissions: B also returns the clearly incomplete span between 1g to. Both systems have three benchmark false positives; an empty target gold must not be described as an absence of quantity information in the source.
ai_notes.context: Numbers and time units alone do not determine Value or Temporal labels. Medication dose and frequency must follow the corpus label scope.

ai_notes.finding: A correctly retains Current but also labels the whole Current or recent phrase as Temporal and labels the full infection description, laboratory abnormalities and Pregnancy as Value. B labels infection and laboratory abnormalities as Measurement.

cases.source:
Type of subject: outpatient. 
Informed consent: Subjects must give their signed and dated written informed consent to participate. 
Gender: Male or female. Female subjects must be post-menopausal or using a highly effective method for avoidance of pregnancy. The decision to include or exclude women of childbearing potential may be made at the discretion of the investigator in accordance with local practice in relation to adequate contraception. 
Age: >=40 and <=80 years of age at Screening (Visit 1). 
Tobacco use: Subjects with a current or prior history of >=10 pack-years of cigarette smoking at screening (Visit 1). Previous smokers are defined as those who have stopped smoking for at least 6 months prior to Visit 1. 
Airflow Obstruction: 
Subjects with a measured post-albuterol/salbutamol forced expiratory volume in 1 second (FEV1)/(forced vital capacity)FVC ratio of <=0.70 at Screening (Visit 1). 
Subjects with a measured post-albuterol/salbutamol FEV1 >=50 and <=70% of predicted normal values calculated using NHANES III reference equations [Hankinson, 1999; Hankinson, 2010] at Screening (Visit 1). 
Post-bronchodilator spirometry will be performed approximately 15 minutes after the subject has self-administered 4 inhalations (i.e., total 400mcg) of albuterol/salbutamol via a metered dose inhaler (MDI )with a valved-holding chamber. The FEV1/FVC ratio and FEV1 percent predicted values will be calculated. 
Symptoms of COPD: Subjects must score 2 or higher on the modified Medical Research Council Dyspnea scale (Visit 1) 
Cardiovascular disease: 
For patients >= 40 years of age: any one of the following: 
Established (i.e. by clinical signs or imaging studies) coronary artery disease (CAD) Established (i.e. by clinical signs or imaging studies) peripheral vascular

ai_notes.boundary_and_omissions: A truncates the long lung-function measurement name; omits values from >=50 and <=70% of predicted normal values; omits for from for at least 6 months prior to Visit 1; and omits score from score 2 or higher. Abbreviations and long compound entities remain difficult.
ai_notes.context: The source combines age, smoking exposure, lung function, a dosing procedure and a clinical score. Segmentation improves coverage but does not reliably distinguish all measurement, dose and timing descriptions.

cases.source:
suspicion of nonfunctional P-NET on primary CT (i.e hypervascularity) or MRI
signed informed consent

ai_notes.finding: The full annotation labels nonfunctional P-NET and hypervascularity as Condition, CT/MRI as Procedure, and signed informed consent as Informed_consent, so the target gold is empty. A labels hypervascularity as Measurement; B places disease/imaging findings and informed consent under Measurement, Value or Temporal.
ai_notes.boundary_and_omissions: A has one and B has three benchmark false positives. Signing consent is not a Temporal entity in this record.
ai_notes.context: Distinguish the three target labels from the full clinical annotation; do not force every medical concept into one of those categories.
